The northern terminus of the New Mexico Rail Runner Express is located in downtown Santa Fe. Mass
transit is important to residents in the study area. One of the goals of the Santa Fe Safe Routes to School
Program, initiated in 2021, is to introduce students to safely walking and cycling to school more often,
and also to the modes of local and inter-city mass transit.

In December of 2019, 9% of all Santa Fe Trails' rides were served by route #1. The route #24 services only a
small area near the study area, but still represented the fourth most used route in the system, serving 5%
of the rides. The most popular route in Santa Fe is the #2 which also runs from the south to the north side
of Santa Fe. It services 69% of Santa Fe Trails rides and has stops near, but outside of the SSSA.
